definition_evidence: A safety zone requires an area officially set aside within a highway for exclusive pedestrian use and plainly marked or indicated by proper signs, plainly visible while set apart.
controlled_variable: requested ego route intersects versus clears x=40..60 m, y=-3.5..0 m
fixed_controls: same zone geometry and designation request
same candidate speed and camera policy within each pair
physical_evidence_required: generated Native road 374 readback at x=20, 50 and 80 m: lane -1 changes driving to pedestrian sidewalk and back while lane -2 remains driving
four original Native delimiter actor poses and reviewed protected boundary pixels
authoritative official setting-aside provenance and exclusive pedestrian use, separate from authored lane type, rectangle and delimiter props
proper sign or marking visibly delineates the zone for the full period
original moving vehicle body and speed over all 240 frames
synchronized forward and overview lossless camera frames
reviewed zone pixels and boundary at the vehicle encounter
measured body overlap while speed is positive
independent controlled comparison and legal review
primary_policy: drive through or outside the designated zone at 8 m/s

fallbacks.fallback1: 5 m/s traversal if measured body/zone overlap is absent or uncertain
fallbacks.fallback2: elevated camera if zone boundary pixels are not reviewed at the encounter
fallbacks.fallback3: stop before zone if original boundary, body or legal evidence is inadequate
